correctness.rationale: Complete all-size proof: any nonalgebraic type corresponds to a legal downset/upset pair. Nonempty upsets correspond to antichains, each admitting 1 plus the number of common strict ancestors as downsets. Double count yields d_v-2 for each strict-ancestor witness; adding the empty-upset term proves the formula. Exhaustive direct-transitivity check on 874 parent-forest instances and 24 closed forms agrees, including n=0.

value.rationale: This is an exact all-size classification of a natural invariant on ancestor-order forests. It identifies a linear-arithmetic tractable family inside a known #P-hard finite-type counting problem, with no need to enumerate exponential many filters, ideals or extensions. It holds uniformly across arbitrary branching and component counts.
